hero.tagline: Digital solutions for your business problems.

about.heading: About Me
about.bio1: I'm Xusan, a developer based in Tashkent. I build websites and web applications, connecting what people see with the systems behind it.
about.bio2_post: . I build clear, responsive experiences that help people find what they need and take the next step.
about.interests: In my free time, I like exploring machine learning, deep learning, and neural networks. I'm curious about how models learn and what we can build with them.

projects.heading: Selected Work
projects.intro: Three projects, three different ways to connect a business with its audience.

uyjoy.description: An apartment discovery platform for residential developments in Uzbekistan. Visitors explore floor plans, compare available homes, and contact the sales team.
uyjoy.alt: UyJoy website with an interactive view of a residential development

faceproduction.description: A website for a casting and talent agency. It brings together project briefs, artist applications, and direct contact for film, advertising, and creative productions.
faceproduction.alt: Face Production casting and talent website

madami.description: A website that explains study-abroad and visa services, introduces the team, and guides prospective students toward a consultation.
madami.alt: Madami Consulting website for study-abroad and visa services

contact.heading: Let's build something useful.
contact.body: Tell me what you want to build, who it's for, and your timeline. We can work out the next step together.
contact.note: For roles and collaborations, send a short introduction and what you’re working on.
